comments.author: CobraChicken
comments.body_html:
Is it really that difficult to be patient and understanding with people on the internet, even if you think the question being asked is stupid? I re-read the description, and certainly, one interpretation is that you are adding a whole new option to pick from. But you could also be adding the option as a replacement to an existing clothing option. Users don’t have the ability to know exactly how modding works, or the nomenclature, and every mod is different. Heck, they might even be an ESL person.

I get it man, writing documentation is a bitch. It’s easily the worst part of my job. But throughout my entire career, one thing I’ve learned is that users don’t think like developers and talking down to them gets everyone nowhere.

Anyway, I apologize for talking out of turn. Have a nice day!

TeufelKrieg: I downloaded the mod and it appears it is fully adding the items into Ragman’s services as opposed to adding them via replacement.
